name: claims-agent
description: Front door for motor claims at Northstar Insurance. Takes a claim as JSON or in the customer's own words, asks for anything missing, and delegates the settlement.

skills.name: File a motor claim as JSON
skills.description: Accept a vehicle-damage claim as a JSON object and drive it to a settlement decision. No model reads it.

skills.name: Report a claim in your own words
skills.description: Accept a first notice of loss as free text. A model reads it into a claim; anything missing or unclear (policy number, date, amount in euro, what happened) is asked for as a follow-up question, and the task waits at input-required until the customer answers on the same task. At most three questions.
examples: Someone reversed into my car in a car park on 2026-10-20. The bumper needs replacing, the garage quoted 1,450 euro. My policy is POL-77120.
A tree branch fell on my car last night and cracked the windscreen.
